MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Janis Joplin's Greatest Hits and Elvis 30 #1 Hits connect with my mid-sixties and AM Gold listening: I want familiar older songs collected in one album.",
    "Best of Bowie and Bob Seger's collection fit the classic rock interest reflected in The Cars and Now Classic Rock Hits, even if I would save them for later."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Alison Krauss and John Mayer live albums have some connection to my listening, but a full live performance is less appealing right now than a collection of familiar hits.",
    "The country collection and newer pop choices feel less connected to my current interest in older rock and sixties songs; my past pop listening does not make them immediate choices.",
    "I cannot tell whether Greatest Hits: Decade #1 fits my tastes without knowing the artist or songs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "A greatest-hits title alone seems to count too much; the artist, era, and songs matter more to me than the collection format by itself.",
    "My occasional pop and folk listening seems to have been stretched into an interest in more pop albums and live sets than I would choose today."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of classic rock, sixties music, and older hits collections better explain what I want now than any single pop album in my history.",
    "There is a difference between something fitting my taste and my wanting it immediately: Bowie and Bob Seger appeal to me, but Janis and Elvis are stronger choices today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in familiar older hits, but extend my broader listening too far beyond what I want right now."
}
